requirements.description: Raw EDGAR 10-K filings, filing date, CIK, fiscal-period metadata and full text for financial-statement complexity, length, actual filing-date returns and the sample frame.

required_coverage.population: Paper-defined EDGAR 10-K sample and full 10-K population used for the 1995–2012 complexity-score construction
required_coverage.detail: The sample is defined on EDGAR 10-K filings for fiscal years 1995–2012. Filing date is an observed filing metadata field and anchors the return and post-filing forecast windows. SEC public access is verified; complete historical population coverage and the 1995 archive subset are not.

routes.mapping_notes: Official EDGAR filing records contain the filing document and CIK/accession/date metadata. Full-text extraction, annual filing-date matching and the complete 1995–2012 population require construction and bounded archive checks.
routes.coverage_notes: Official source access is verified; complete coverage of the required historical population is not established.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The SEC page confirms public access but not complete historical coverage of this paper-defined EDGAR population; 1995 filings were still in EDGAR phase-in.

requirements.description: I/B/E/S management-guidance announcements used to count forecasts in the twelve months after each 10-K filing.

required_coverage.population: Guidance for U.S. firms matched to the selected 10-K EDGAR population; announcement dates fall in the twelve months after actual filing dates
required_coverage.detail: The local catalog contains DET_GUIDANCE announcement dates, periodicity, measure, fiscal-year/month and guidance values. The table does not define which measure codes count as one forecast or how forecast ranges/revisions are deduplicated.

routes.mapping_notes: Exact fields are probed. `measure`/`pdicity`, range/revision deduplication and company-to-Compustat identity semantics need the paper’s historical I/B/E/S Guidance definitions.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No local coverage confirmation establishes complete 1995–2013 management-guidance history for sample firms.

requirements.description: Compustat annual financial and market-equity inputs for controls, the 10-K sample screens and firm-year linking.

required_coverage.population: EDGAR 10-K firms with complete Compustat controls for fiscal years 1995–2012
required_coverage.detail: Required fields include assets, book liabilities/equity, shares, fiscal year-end price, income, special items and identifiers. The paper uses current-fiscal-year control values.

routes.mapping_notes: Exact annual Compustat fields are present. The paper’s industry-year ROA adjustment is a separate unresolved construction rule.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes 1995–2012 population coverage for firms with EDGAR filings and all controls.

requirements.description: CRSP monthly firm returns and return history for the twelve months before each actual 10-K filing date.

required_coverage.population: Firms in the EDGAR filing sample with twelve monthly returns before each 10-K filing date, matched to Compustat
required_coverage.detail: The 12-month return and standard-deviation windows are anchored on actual filing dates. Fiscal-year 1995–2012 filing dates may occur in subsequent calendar years; bounds conservatively include the preceding and following calendar envelope.

routes.mapping_notes: Exact CRSP monthly date/return fields are present; firm-month coverage and historical link validity remain unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.description: Full 10-K disclosure population used to normalize and estimate the readability principal component before Compustat-control screens.

required_coverage.population: All 86,236 eligible 10-K firm-years used in the paper’s first-component construction, not just the 72,366 regression sample
required_coverage.detail: The PCA is formed before the smaller regression control-data screens. The required text population and exact normalization procedure must remain separate from the main baseline fit population.

routes.mapping_notes: Public 10-K text is a plausible raw reconstruction route, but complete 86,236-document EDGAR population and normalization mapping are not verified.
routes.coverage_notes: Official source access is verified; complete coverage of the required historical population is not established.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No source establishes complete coverage of the 86,236-document PCA fit population or the paper’s normalization method.

requirements.description: Industry-year adjustment applied to income-before-extraordinary-items divided by total assets for the ROA control.

required_coverage.population: Each sample firm’s fiscal-year ROA and its industry-year comparison population
required_coverage.detail: Underlying ROA is ib/at, but the paper does not specify the adjustment group, weighting, missing-cell rule or population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The industry-year adjustment population and formula are not reported; raw Compustat values do not resolve them.

requirements.description: Annual decile-rank population and tie handling for independent variables scaled to [0,1].

required_coverage.population: All complete observations eligible for each regression before or after control-data screens, as defined by the paper
required_coverage.detail: The paper reports decile ranks on a 0–1 scale but the exact ranked population and tie handling are not fixed in the frozen item.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The annual rank benchmark population and tied-rank convention are not verified.

requirements.description: Construct the 1995–2012 EDGAR 10-K regression sample using sufficient Compustat control data and twelve months of CRSP monthly returns before filing; preserve the 72,366 baseline observations and the larger 86,236-document PCA population.

required_coverage.population: Paper-defined EDGAR filers with Compustat controls and pre-filing CRSP returns; PCA scores use the full document population before the control screens
required_coverage.detail: Do not substitute the 86,236-document factor-fit population for the smaller regression population. The EDGAR filer universe is distinct from all registrants.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Sample screens can be constructed from the listed raw data, but no coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the complete regression or PCA populations.

The I/B/E/S Guidance measure-code, periodicity, revision and range-deduplication rules needed to count management forecasts are not stated.

1995 electronic EDGAR filing coverage was still phased in. The public SEC route can support the paper-defined EDGAR sample, but does not establish a complete all-registrant 1995 cohort.

Local exact probes verify access/columns only; no local coverage confirmations were supplied for this item. Public EDGAR routes are recorded where relevant, with historical population gaps preserved.
